Class GroovyMolecules

java.lang.Object
com.cleanroommc.groovyscript.registry.NamedRegistry
com.cleanroommc.groovyscript.registry.VirtualizedRegistry<MoleculeSpec>
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.compat.groovy.GroovyMolecules
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.cleanroommc.groovyscript.api.INamed, com.cleanroommc.groovyscript.api.IScriptReloadable
public final class GroovyMolecules extends com.cleanroommc.groovyscript.registry.VirtualizedRegistry<MoleculeSpec>
Reloadable script contribution above server JSON, using the same builder and validation as Java.
